summary: The sidebar-style navigation menu used to move between sections of a settings page.
description: A grouping of navigation buttons displayed at the page level, used to change the selected view, provide a heading, and link to external resources. Manages selection state across its slotted moz-page-nav-button children and supports a secondary/footer nav group.

attributes.name: currentView
attributes.description: The currently selected view; matched against each moz-page-nav-button's view attribute.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: A heading displayed at the top of the navigation.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the component. "mobile" shows a hamburger menu button before the logo/heading; default (unset) shows the standard nav.

attributes.name: allowNoSelection
attributes.description: When false (default), the component auto-selects the first visible button whenever currentView does not match any button. When true, a non-matching currentView is allowed to persist without forcing a selection (used by about:preferences for sub-pages/search-results states where no category should be highlighted).

attributes.name: pageNavButtons
attributes.description: Internal/read state: the array of all slotted primary moz-page-nav-button elements, derived from slotchange.

attributes.name: secondaryNavButtons
attributes.description: Internal/read state: the array of all slotted secondary-nav moz-page-nav-button elements, derived from slotchange.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: Used to append moz-page-nav-button elements to the primary navigation.

slots.name: subheading
slots.description: Used to append page-specific search input or notification content below the heading.

slots.name: secondary-nav
slots.description: Used to append a secondary/footer group of moz-page-nav-button elements, separated from the primary group by an <hr> when present. Found in render()/onSecondaryNavChange but not documented in the class JSDoc.
